title: Letters made of thread
alt: Stitched coral, indigo and ivory letters spell THREAD on a linen worktable.
description: Readable typography combines fabric edges, visible stitches and a carefully arranged textile still life.
prompt: A sophisticated design photograph of the single word THREAD, spelled exactly with large separate three-dimensional capital letters made from thick woven cotton and silk, with visible stitches, folded edges and rich coral, indigo and ivory fibres. The letters stand in correct order and are completely readable, without touching or merging. Arrange them on a cream linen worktable with neat thread spools and small fabric swatches. Rich tactile detail, consistent refined product lighting, physically supported objects, careful magazine-quality art direction. No extra writing.
